input.quote: (d) Conditions for Transfers of Additional Receivables. The transfer and assignment of the Additional Receivables and the other related Depositor Transferred Property on each Acquisition Date will be subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions on or before such Acquisition Date:
input.rationale: No take-or-pay, minimum purchase, volume-floor or shortfall-penalty obligation is imposed on the Issuer or the Depositor anywhere in the Agreement. Acquisitions of Additional Receivables under Section 2.1(b) occur only on an Acquisition Date, are conditioned on satisfaction of Section 2.1(d) (Transfer Notice, Credit Enhancement Test, Pool Composition Tests and Depositor certifications), and the Issuer's consideration is limited to the Additional Receivables Cash Transfer Amount for the Receivables actually transferred on that date — i.e., payment for assets actually acquired rather than a committed volume. Section 2.1(c) expressly confirms the Issuer assumes no other obligations. The Required Acquisition Deposit Amount and Required Negative Carry Amount constructs (p0225, p0398, p0564, p0927) are Revolving Period waterfall/credit-enhancement mechanics funded from the Issuer's own collections, not a purchase commitment; and the Credit Payment/shortfall deposit duty in Section 4.3(h) (p0211) runs against the Marketing Agent (counterparty side) and benefits us. This sits at the preferred position — no minimum commitment, with amounts payable only for assets actually acquired — so no redline is warranted.
